Select the first 500 activity rows for compounds tested against target CHEMBL206. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, and target_dictionary, filtering by target_dictionary.chembl_id. Require compound structures via an INNER JOIN to compound_structures. Return chembl_id, canonical_smiles, standard_type, standard_value, and standard_units. Sort results by potency (standard_value ascending) and limit to 500 rows.
